easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control another nontoken creature.
description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and another nontoken creature.
When the creatures are sacrificed, Szarel triggers twice, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to twice Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
